Name: }bedrock.process.execute_http_request

Parameters.Name: pMethod
Parameters.Prompt: REQUIRED: Method of the http request

Parameters.Name: pURL
Parameters.Prompt: REQUIRED: The URL to send the request to

Parameters.Name: pURLPath
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: URL Path to append to pURL

Parameters.Name: pHeaders
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: JSON Array of headers for the request (Default = '[]')

Parameters.Name: pResponseFile
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: The file name to write the response to

Parameters.Name: pCertificateFile
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: The file name of a custom CA certificate file

Parameters.Name: pVerify
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Verify the TLS certificates (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pResponseHeaders
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: JSON Array of headers to include in return value

Parameters.Name: pContext
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Set the session's context to this value (Default = 'BedrockTop')

Parameters.Name: pLogOutput
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Write parameters and action summary to server message log (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pStrictErrorHandling
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: On encountering any error, exit with major error status by ProcessQuit after writing to the server message log (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pJson
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: JSON Object with process parameter values. This will overwrite user passed parameters for all included parameters.
